# VibeCode Arcade

Free, open-source home for games made by vibecoding. Every listing is free, ships its source, and ships the prompt that made it. No accounts, payments, DRM, tracking, or affiliate links.

Live site: https://arcade.sockwaffle.com
Source: https://github.com/dirtcodevet/vibecode-arcade
Submit a game: https://github.com/dirtcodevet/vibecode-arcade/issues/new?template=submit-a-game.yml
Admission rules: https://github.com/dirtcodevet/vibecode-arcade/blob/main/docs/rules.md

Sister brand: PriceRook (https://pricerook.com), a PC game and hardware deals site. Talk shop in the PriceRook Discord's Gamers Bench: https://discord.gg/T3qyuDyqtA

The public catalog is catalog/shelf.json. It lists only in-repo packages that pass src/framework/rules.ts. Painted storefront cards on the reveal site are examples, not catalog entries.
